versions.changelog:
**Adds exclusion of resolved review thread comments, and new flag for including them.**  
- Line-specific review comments from resolved threads are now excluded by default.
- New flag `--include-resolved` includes resolved-thread comments if set.
- Documentation and instructions updated for new resolved-thread filtering logic.
- Pagination/GraphQL limitations for very large PRs documented.
- `skill-card.md` file removed.

- Adds detailed instructions for fetching, cleaning, and grouping GitHub PR review comments.
- Supports new `--pr <number>` and `--include-author` flags for flexible PR targeting and author inclusion.
- Improves comment noise-stripping to handle bot/generated content and large comments for concise feedback.
- Formats feedback by grouping reviewer comments into summary and line-specific sections.
- Returns early if no relevant comments are found.
- Integrates with the receive-feedback skill to evaluate and process actionable review feedback.
